_comment: Frame 7, once per scent. The frame shows no product so its content is scent-agnostic, but an unscoped media in a scoped gallery is hidden for every variant — the theme's gang_exist flag is sticky. So it is duplicated rather than left unscoped.

images.alt: A diagram of where the 90-Day Coconut Reset is used: shoulders, chest and back, elbows, hands, legs and heels are marked on a body silhouette. The face is not marked. Made for your body, not your face.
